summary: Aura Minerals filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 5, 2026 press release announcing a declared quarterly cash dividend of US$0.72 per common share, approximately US$60.42 million in aggregate, with a record date of November 18, 2026 and payment on November 27, 2026; BDR holders receive US$0.24 per BDR (one share equals three BDRs), payable around December 8, 2026 in Brazilian Reais at a future disclosed exchange rate. The payout exceeds the Dividend Policy minimum of 20% of quarterly Adjusted EBITDA less sustaining and exploration capex. No advisor or board recommendation disclosed. Watch for FX-driven BDR payout variance and any buyback activity cited in the ~4% LTM shareholder yield.
